verses.lat: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy indignation, nor chastise me in Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum; sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

verses.lat: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde; sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
verses.eng: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: but Thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.lat: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam; salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: O save me for Thy mercy's sake.

verses.lat: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui; in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
verses.eng: For there is no one in death that is mindful of Thee: and who shall confess to Thee in hell?

verses.lat: Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum; lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
verses.eng: I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: I will water my couch with my tears.

verses.lat: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus; inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
verses.eng: My eye is troubled through indignation: I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

verses.lat: Discédite a me, omnes qui operámini iniquitátem, quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
verses.eng: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.lat: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam; Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard my supplication: the Lord hath received my prayer.

verses.lat: Erubéscant et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei; convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
verses.eng: Let all my enemies be ashamed and be very much troubled: let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo; narrábo ómnia mirabília tua.
verses.eng: I will give praise to Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: I will relate all Thy wonders.

verses.lat: Lætábor et exsultábo in te; psallam nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.eng: I will be glad and rejoice in Thee: I will sing to Thy name, O Thou most High.

verses.lat: In converténdo inimícum meum retrorsum; infirmabúntur et períbunt a fácie tua.
verses.eng: When my enemy shall be turned back: they shall be weakened and perish before Thy face.

verses.lat: Quóniam fecísti judícium meum et causam meam; sedísti super thronum, qui júdicas justítiam.
verses.eng: For Thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: Thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.

verses.lat: Increpásti gentes, et périit ímpius; nomen eórum delésti in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Inimíci defecérunt frámeæ in finem, et civitátes eórum destruxísti. Périit memória eórum cum sónitu;
verses.eng: The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: and their cities Thou hast destroyed. Their memory hath perished with a noise;

verses.lat: Et Dóminus in ætérnum pérmanet. Parávit in judício thronum suum;
verses.eng: But the Lord remaineth for ever. He hath prepared His throne in judgment;

verses.lat: Et ipse judicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, judicábit pópulos in justítia.
verses.eng: And He shall judge the world in equity, He shall judge the people in justice.

verses.lat: Et factus est Dóminus refúgium páuperi, adjútor in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne.
verses.eng: And the Lord is become a refuge for the poor: a helper in due time in tribulation.

verses.lat: Et sperent in te qui novérunt nomen tuum, quóniam non dereliquísti quæréntes te, Dómine.
verses.eng: And let them trust in Thee who know Thy name: for Thou hast not forsaken them that seek Thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Psállite Dómino, qui hábitat in Sion; annuntiáte inter gentes stúdia ejus.
verses.eng: Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: declare His ways among the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Quóniam requírens sánguinem eórum recordátus est; non est oblítus clamórem páuperum.
verses.eng: For requiring their blood He hath remembered them: He hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine; vide humilitátem meam de inimícis meis.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord: see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.

verses.lat: Qui exáltas me de portis mortis, ut annúntiem omnes laudatiónes tuas in portis fíliæ Sion.
verses.eng: Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death, that I may declare all Thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

verses.lat: Exsultábo in salutári tuo. Infíxæ sunt gentes in intéritu quem fecérunt.
verses.eng: I will rejoice in Thy salvation. The Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they have prepared.

verses.lat: In láqueo isto quem abscondérunt, comprehénsus est pes eórum.
verses.eng: Their foot hath been taken in the very snare which they hid.

verses.lat: Cognoscétur Dóminus judícia fáciens; in opéribus mánuum suárum comprehénsus est peccátor.
verses.eng: The Lord shall be known when He executeth judgments: the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.

verses.lat: Convertántur peccatóres in inférnum, omnes gentes quæ obliviscúntur Deum.
verses.eng: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.

verses.lat: Quóniam non in finem oblívio erit páuperis; patiéntia páuperum non períbit in finem.
verses.eng: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.lat: Exsúrge, Dómine, non confortétur homo; judicéntur gentes in conspéctu tuo.
verses.eng: Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: let the Gentiles be judged in Thy sight.

verses.lat: Constítue, Dómine, legislatórem super eos, ut sciant gentes quóniam hómines sunt.
verses.eng: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ut quid, Dómine, recessísti longe, déspicis in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne?
verses.eng: Why, O Lord, hast Thou retired afar off? Why dost Thou slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?

verses.lat: Dum supérbit ímpius, incénditur pauper; comprehendúntur in consíliis quibus cógitant.
verses.eng: Whilst the wicked man is proud, the poor is set on fire: they are caught in the counsels which they devise.

verses.lat: Quóniam laudátur peccátor in desidériis ánimæ suæ, et iníquus benedícitur.
verses.eng: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul: and the unjust man is blessed.

verses.lat: Exacerbávit Dóminum peccátor: secúndum multitúdinem iræ suæ non quǽret.
verses.eng: The sinner hath provoked the Lord: according to the multitude of His wrath He will not seek him.

verses.lat: Non est Deus in conspéctu ejus; inquinátæ sunt viæ illíus in omni témpore.
verses.eng: God is not before his eyes: his ways are filthy at all times.

verses.lat: Auferúntur judícia tua a fácie ejus; ómnium inimicórum suórum dominábitur.
verses.eng: Thy judgments are removed from his sight: he shall rule over all his enemies.

verses.lat: Dixit enim in corde suo: Non movébor a generatióne in generatiónem sine malo.
verses.eng: For he hath said in his heart: I shall not be moved from generation to generation, and shall be without evil.

verses.lat: Cujus maledictióne os plenum est et amaritúdine et dolo; sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.
verses.eng: His mouth is full of cursing and of bitterness and of deceit: under his tongue are labour and sorrow.

verses.lat: Sedet in insídiis cum divítibus in occúltis, ut interfíciat innocéntem.
verses.eng: He sitteth in ambush with the rich in private places, that he may kill the innocent.

verses.lat: Óculi ejus in páuperem respíciunt; insidiátur in abscóndito, quasi leo in spelúnca sua.
verses.eng: His eyes are upon the poor man: he lieth in wait in secret like a lion in his den.

verses.lat: Insidiátur ut rápiat páuperem; rápere páuperem dum áttrahit eum.
verses.eng: He lieth in ambush that he may catch the poor man: to catch the poor, whilst he draweth him to him.

verses.lat: In láqueo suo humiliábit eum; inclinábit se et cadet, cum dominátus fúerit páuperum.
verses.eng: In his net he will bring him down, he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.

verses.lat: Dixit enim in corde suo: Oblítus est Deus, avértit fáciem suam ne vídeat in finem.
verses.eng: For he hath said in his heart: God hath forgotten, He hath turned away His face not to see to the end.

verses.lat: Exsúrge, Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua; ne obliviscáris páuperum.
verses.eng: Arise, O Lord God, let Thy hand be exalted: forget not the poor.

verses.lat: Propter quid irritávit ímpius Deum? Dixit enim in corde suo: Non requíret.
verses.eng: Wherefore hath the wicked provoked God? For he hath said in his heart: He will not require it.

verses.lat: Vides, quóniam tu labórem et dolórem consíderas, ut tradas eos in manus tuas.
verses.eng: Thou seest it, for Thou considerest labour and sorrow: that Thou mayst deliver them into Thy hands.

verses.lat: Tibi derelíctus est pauper; órphano tu eris adjútor.
verses.eng: To Thee is the poor man left: Thou wilt be a helper to the orphan.

verses.lat: Cóntere brácchium peccatóris et malígni; quærétur peccátum illíus et non inveniétur.
verses.eng: Break Thou the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.

verses.lat: Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi; períbitis, gentes, de terra illíus.
verses.eng: The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: ye Gentiles shall perish from His land.

verses.lat: Desidérium páuperum exaudívit Dóminus; præparatiónem cordis eórum audívit auris tua.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard the desire of the poor: Thy ear hath heard the preparation of their heart.

verses.lat: Judicáre pupíllo et húmili, ut non appónat ultra magnificáre se homo super terram.
verses.eng: To judge for the fatherless and for the humble, that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Díligam te, Dómine, fortitúdo mea.
verses.eng: I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength.

verses.lat: Dóminus firmaméntum meum, et refúgium meum, et liberátor meus.
verses.eng: The Lord is my firmament, my refuge, and my deliverer.

verses.lat: Deus meus, adjútor meus, et sperábo in eum. Protéctor meus, et cornu salútis meæ, et suscéptor meus.
verses.eng: My God is my helper, and in Him will I put my trust. My protector, and the horn of my salvation, and my support.

verses.lat: Laudans invocábo Dóminum, et ab inimícis meis salvus ero.
verses.eng: Praising, I will call upon the Lord: and I shall be saved from my enemies.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis, et torréntes iniquitátis conturbavérunt me.
verses.eng: The sorrows of death surrounded me: and the torrents of iniquity troubled me.

verses.lat: Dolóres inférni circumdedérunt me; præoccupavérunt me láquei mortis.
verses.eng: The sorrows of hell encompassed me: and the snares of death prevented me.

verses.lat: In tribulatióne mea invocávi Dóminum, et ad Deum meum clamávi.
verses.eng: In my affliction I called upon the Lord, and I cried to my God.

verses.lat: Et exaudívit de templo sancto suo vocem meam, et clamor meus in conspéctu ejus introívit in aures ejus.
verses.eng: And He heard my voice from His holy temple: and my cry before Him came into His ears.

verses.lat: Commóta est et contrémuit terra; fundaménta móntium conturbáta sunt et commóta sunt, quóniam irátus est eis.
verses.eng: The earth shook and trembled: the foundations of the mountains were troubled and were moved, because He was angry with them.

verses.lat: Ascéndit fumus in ira ejus, et ignis a fácie ejus exársit; carbónes succénsi sunt ab eo.
verses.eng: There went up a smoke in His wrath: and a fire flamed from His face: coals were kindled by it.

verses.lat: Inclinávit cælos et descéndit, et calígo sub pédibus ejus.
verses.eng: He bowed the heavens and came down: and darkness was under His feet.

verses.lat: Et ascéndit super chérubim et volávit; volávit super pennas ventórum.
verses.eng: And He ascended upon the cherubim and flew: He flew upon the wings of the winds.

verses.lat: Et pósuit ténebras latíbulum suum; in circúitu ejus tabernáculum ejus, tenebrósa aqua in núbibus áëris.
verses.eng: And He made darkness His covert, His pavilion round about Him: dark waters in the clouds of the air.

verses.lat: Præ fulgóre in conspéctu ejus nubes transiérunt, grando et carbónes ignis.
verses.eng: At the brightness that was before Him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.

verses.lat: Et intónuit de cælo Dóminus, et Altíssimus dedit vocem suam; grando et carbónes ignis.
verses.eng: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Highest gave His voice: hail and coals of fire.

verses.lat: Et misit sagíttas suas et dissipávit eos; fúlgura multiplicávit et conturbávit eos.
verses.eng: And He sent forth His arrows and He scattered them: He multiplied lightnings, and troubled them.

verses.lat: Et apparuérunt fontes aquárum, et reveláta sunt fundaménta orbis terrárum.
verses.eng: Then the fountains of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were discovered.

verses.lat: Ab increpatióne tua, Dómine, ab inspiratióne spíritus iræ tuæ.
verses.eng: At Thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the spirit of Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Misit de summo et accépit me, et assúmpsit me de aquis multis.
verses.eng: He sent from on high, and took me: and received me out of many waters.

verses.lat: Erípuit me de inimícis meis fortíssimis, et ab his qui odérunt me, quóniam confortáti sunt super me.
verses.eng: He delivered me from my strongest enemies, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.lat: Prævenérunt me in die afflictiónis meæ; et factus est Dóminus protéctor meus.
verses.eng: They prevented me in the day of my affliction: and the Lord became my protector.

verses.lat: Et edúxit me in latitúdinem; salvum me fecit, quóniam vóluit me.
verses.eng: And He brought me forth into a large place: He saved me, because He was well pleased with me.

verses.lat: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam, et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum retríbuet mihi.
verses.eng: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands.

verses.lat: Quia custodívi vias Dómini, nec ímpie gessi a Deo meo.
verses.eng: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not done wickedly against my God.

verses.lat: Quóniam ómnia judícia ejus in conspéctu meo, et justítias ejus non répuli a me.
verses.eng: For all His judgments are in my sight: and His justices I have not put away from me.

verses.lat: Et ero immaculátus cum eo, et observábo me ab iniquitáte mea.
verses.eng: And I shall be spotless with Him: and I shall keep myself from my iniquity.

verses.lat: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam, et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum in conspéctu oculórum ejus.
verses.eng: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: and according to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.

verses.lat: Cum sancto sanctus eris, et cum viro innocénte ínnocens eris.
verses.eng: With the holy Thou wilt be holy: and with the innocent man Thou wilt be innocent.

verses.lat: Et cum elécto eléctus eris, et cum pervérso pervertéris.
verses.eng: And with the elect Thou wilt be elect: and with the perverse Thou wilt be perverted.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu pópulum húmilem salvum fácies, et óculos superbórum humiliábis.
verses.eng: For Thou wilt save the humble people: but wilt bring down the eyes of the proud.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, impollúta via ejus; elóquia Dómini igne examináta: protéctor est ómnium speántium in se.
verses.eng: As for my God, His way is undefiled: the words of the Lord are fire-tried: He is the protector of all that trust in Him.

verses.lat: Quóniam quis Deus præter Dóminum? Aut quis Deus præter Deum nostrum?
verses.eng: For who is God but the Lord? Or who is God but our God?

verses.lat: Deus qui præcínxit me virtúte, et pósuit immaculátam viam meam.
verses.eng: God who hath girt me with strength, and made my way blameless.

verses.lat: Qui perfécit pedes meos tamquam cervórum, et super excélsa státuens me.
verses.eng: Who hath made my feet like the feet of harts, and who setteth me upon high places.

verses.lat: Qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium; et posuísti, ut arcum ǽreum, bráchia mea.
verses.eng: Who teacheth my hands to war: and Thou hast made my arms like a brazen bow.

verses.lat: Et dedísti mihi protectiónem salútis tuæ, et déxtera tua suscépit me.
verses.eng: And Thou hast given me the protection of Thy salvation: and Thy right hand hath held me up.

verses.lat: Et disiplína tua corréxit me in finem, et disciplína tua ipsa me docébit.
verses.eng: And Thy discipline hath corrected me unto the end: and Thy discipline, the same shall teach me.

verses.lat: Dilatásti gressus meos subtus me, et non sunt infirmáta vestígia mea.
verses.eng: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me: and my feet are not weakened.

verses.lat: Pérsequar inimícos meos et comprehéndam illos, et non convértar donec defíciant.
verses.eng: I will pursue after my enemies and overtake them: and I will not turn again till they are consumed.

verses.lat: Confríngam illos, nec póterunt stare; cadent subtus pedes meos.
verses.eng: I will break them, and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet.

verses.lat: Et præcinxísti me virtúte ad bellum, et supplantásti insurgéntes in me subtus me.
verses.eng: And Thou hast girded me with strength unto battle: and hast subdued under me them that rose up against me.

verses.lat: Et inimícos meos dedísti mihi dorsum, et odiéntes me disperdidísti.
verses.eng: And Thou hast made my enemies turn their back upon me, and hast destroyed them that hated me.

verses.lat: Clamavérunt, nec erat qui salvos fáceret; ad Dóminum, nec exaudívit eos.
verses.eng: They cried, but there was none to save them; to the Lord, but He heard them not.

verses.lat: Et commínuam eos ut púlverem ante fáciem venti; ut lutum plateárum delébo eos.
verses.eng: And I shall beat them as small as the dust before the wind: I shall bring them to nought, like the dirt in the streets.

verses.lat: Erípies me de contradictiónibus pópuli; constítues me in caput géntium.
verses.eng: Thou wilt deliver me from the contradictions of the people: Thou wilt make me head of the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Pópulus quem non cognóvi servívit mihi; in audítu auris obœdívit mihi.
verses.eng: A people which I knew not hath served me: at the hearing of the ear they have obeyed me.

verses.lat: Fílii aliéni mentíti sunt mihi; fílii aliéni inveteráti sunt et claudicavérunt a sémitis suis.
verses.eng: The children that are strangers have lied to me; strange children have faded away, and have halted from their paths.

verses.lat: Vivit Dóminus, et benedíctus Deus meus, et exaltétur Deus salútis meæ.
verses.eng: The Lord liveth, and blessed be my God: and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.lat: Deus qui das vindíctas mihi et subdis pópulos sub me, liberátor meus de inimícis meis iracúndis.
verses.eng: O God, who avengest me and subduest the people under me, my deliverer from my enraged enemies.

verses.lat: Et ab insurgéntibus in me exaltábis me; a viro iníquo erípies me.
verses.eng: And Thou wilt lift me up above them that rise up against me: from the unjust man Thou wilt deliver me.

verses.lat: Proptérea confitébor tibi in natiónibus, Dómine, et nómini tuo psalmum dicam.
verses.eng: Therefore will I give glory to Thee, O Lord, among the nations: and I will sing a psalm to Thy name.

verses.lat: Magníficans salútes regis ejus, et fáciens misericórdiam christo suo David, et sémini ejus usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: Giving great deliverance to His king, and showing mercy to David, His anointed, and to his seed for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis; prótegat te nomen Dei Jacob.
verses.eng: May the Lord hear thee in the day of tribulation: may the name of the God of Jacob protect thee.

verses.lat: Mittat tibi auxílium de sancto, et de Sion tueátur te.
verses.eng: May He send thee help from the sanctuary, and defend thee out of Sion.

verses.lat: Memor sit omnis sacrifícii tui, et holocáustum tuum píngue fiat.
verses.eng: May He be mindful of all thy sacrifices, and may thy whole burnt offering be made fat.

verses.lat: Tríbuat tibi secúndum cor tuum, et omne consílium tuum confírmet.
verses.eng: May He give thee according to thy own heart, and confirm all thy counsels.

verses.lat: Lætábimur in salutári tuo; et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur.
verses.eng: We will rejoice in thy salvation: and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.

verses.lat: Ímpleat Dóminus omnes petitiónes tuas. Nunc cognóvi quóniam salvum fecit Dóminus christum suum.
verses.eng: The Lord fulfil all thy petitions. Now have I known that the Lord hath saved His anointed.

verses.lat: Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo, in poténtátibus salus déxteræ ejus.
verses.eng: He will hear him from His holy heaven: the salvation of His right hand is in powers.

verses.lat: Hi in cúrribus et hi in equis; nos autem in nómine Dómini Dei nostri invocábimus.
verses.eng: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will call upon the name of the Lord our God.

verses.lat: Ipsi obligáti sunt et cecidérunt; nos autem surréximus et erécti sumus.
verses.eng: They are bound and have fallen: but we are risen and are set upright.

verses.lat: Dómine, salvum fac regem, et exáudi nos in die qua invocavérimus te.
verses.eng: O Lord, save the king, and hear us in the day that we shall call upon Thee.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, in virtúte tua lætábitur rex, et super salutáre tuum exsultábit veheménter.
verses.eng: In Thy strength, O Lord, the king shall joy: and in Thy salvation he shall rejoice exceedingly.

verses.lat: Desidérium cordis ejus tribuísti ei, et voluntáte labiórum ejus non fraudásti eum.
verses.eng: Thou hast given him his heart's desire: and hast not withholden from him the will of his lips.

verses.lat: Quóniam prævenísti eum in benedictiónibus dulcédinis; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
verses.eng: For Thou hast prevented him with blessings of sweetness: Thou hast set on his head a crown of precious stones.

verses.lat: Vitam pétiit a te, et tribuísti ei longitúdinem diérum in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: He asked life of Thee: and Thou hast given him length of days for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Magna est glória ejus in salutári tuo; glóriam et magnum decórem impónes super eum.
verses.eng: His glory is great in Thy salvation: glory and great beauty shalt Thou lay upon him.

verses.lat: Quóniam dabis eum in benedictiónem in sǽculum sǽculi; lætificábis eum in gáudio cum vultu tuo.
verses.eng: For Thou shalt give him to be a blessing for ever and ever: Thou shalt make him joyful in gladness with Thy countenance.

verses.lat: Quóniam rex sperat in Dómino, et in misericórdia Altíssimi non commovébitur.
verses.eng: For the king hopeth in the Lord: and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.lat: Inveniátur manus tua ómnibus inimícis tuis; déxtera tua invéniat omnes qui te odérunt.
verses.eng: Let Thy hand be found by all Thy enemies: let Thy right hand find out all them that hate Thee.

verses.lat: Pones eos ut clíbanum ignis in témpore vultus tui: Dóminus in ira sua conturbábit eos, et devorábit eos ignis.
verses.eng: Thou shalt make them as an oven of fire in the time of Thy anger: the Lord shall trouble them in His wrath, and fire shall devour them.

verses.lat: Fructum eórum de terra perdes, et semen eórum a fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Their fruit shalt Thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.lat: Quóniam declinavérunt in te mala; cogitavérunt consília quæ non potuérunt stabilíre.
verses.eng: For they have intended evils against Thee: they have devised counsels which they have not been able to establish.

verses.lat: Quóniam pones eos dorsum; in relíquiis tuis præparábis vultum eórum.
verses.eng: For Thou shalt make them turn their back: in Thy remnants Thou shalt prepare their face.

verses.lat: Exaltáre, Dómine, in virtúte tua; cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas.
verses.eng: Be Thou exalted, O Lord, in Thy own strength: we will sing and praise Thy power.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? Longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
verses.eng: O God, my God, look upon me: why hast Thou forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

verses.lat: Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies; et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
verses.eng: O my God, I shall cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear: and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

verses.lat: Tu autem in sancto hábitas, laus Israël.
verses.eng: But Thou dwellest in the holy place, the praise of Israel.

verses.lat: In te speravérunt patres nostri; speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
verses.eng: In Thee have our fathers hoped: they have hoped, and Thou hast delivered them.

verses.lat: Ad te clamavérunt et salvi facti sunt; in te speravérunt et non sunt confúsi.
verses.eng: They cried to Thee, and they were saved: they trusted in Thee, and were not confounded.

verses.lat: Ego autem sum vermis et non homo; oppróbrium hóminum et abjéctio plebis.
verses.eng: But I am a worm, and no man: the reproach of men and the outcast of the people.

verses.lat: Omnes vidéntes me derisérunt me; locúti sunt lábiis et movérunt caput.
verses.eng: All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: they have spoken with the lips and wagged the head.

verses.lat: Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum; salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
verses.eng: He hoped in the Lord, let Him deliver him: let Him save him, seeing He delighteth in him.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu es qui extraxísti me de ventre; spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ.
verses.eng: For Thou art He that hast drawn me out of the womb: my hope from the breasts of my mother.

verses.lat: In te projéctus sum ex útero; de ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu.
verses.eng: I was cast upon Thee from the womb; from my mother's womb Thou art my God.

verses.lat: Ne discésseris a me, quóniam tribulátio próxima est, quóniam non est qui ádjuvet.
verses.eng: Depart not from me, for tribulation is very near: for there is none to help me.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi; tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
verses.eng: Many calves have surrounded me: fat bulls have besieged me.

verses.lat: Aperuérunt super me os suum, sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
verses.eng: They have opened their mouths against me, as a lion ravening and roaring.

verses.lat: Sicut aqua effúsus sum, et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.
verses.eng: I am poured out like water: and all my bones are scattered.

verses.lat: Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens in médio ventris mei.
verses.eng: My heart is become like wax melting in the midst of my bowels.

verses.lat: Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis; et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
verses.eng: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: and Thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

verses.lat: Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi; concílium malignántium obsédit me.
verses.eng: For many dogs have encompassed me: the council of the malignant hath besieged me.

verses.lat: Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos; dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
verses.eng: They have dug my hands and feet: they have numbered all my bones.

verses.lat: Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me; divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
verses.eng: And they have looked and stared upon me: they parted my garments amongst them, and upon my vesture they cast lots.

verses.lat: Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me; ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, remove not Thy help to a distance from me: look towards my defence.

verses.lat: Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam, et de manu canis únicam meam.
verses.eng: Deliver, O God, my soul from the sword: my only one from the hand of the dog.

verses.lat: Salva me ex ore leónis, et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.
verses.eng: Save me from the lion's mouth: and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis; in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
verses.eng: I will declare Thy name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I praise Thee.

verses.lat: Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum; univérsum semen Jacob, glorificáte eum.
verses.eng: Ye that fear the Lord, praise Him: all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify Him.

verses.lat: Tímeat eum omne semen Israël, quóniam non sprevit neque despéxit deprecatiónem páuperis.
verses.eng: Let all the seed of Israel fear Him: because He hath not slighted nor despised the supplication of the poor man.

verses.lat: Nec avértit fáciem suam a me; et cum clamárem ad eum, exaudívit me.
verses.eng: Neither hath He turned away His face from me: and when I cried to Him, He heard me.

verses.lat: Apud te laus mea in ecclésia magna; vota mea reddam in conspéctu timéntium eum.
verses.eng: With Thee is my praise in a great church: I will pay my vows in the sight of them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Edent páuperes et saturabúntur, et laudábunt Dóminum qui requírunt eum: vivent corda eórum in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: The poor shall eat and shall be filled: and they shall praise the Lord that seek Him: their hearts shall live for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Reminiscéntur et converténtur ad Dóminum univérsi fines terræ.
verses.eng: All the ends of the earth shall remember and shall be converted to the Lord.

verses.lat: Et adorábunt in conspéctu ejus univérsæ famíliæ géntium.
verses.eng: And all the kindreds of the Gentiles shall adore in His sight.

verses.lat: Quóniam Dómini est regnum, et ipse dominábitur géntium.
verses.eng: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and He shall have dominion over the nations.

verses.lat: Manducavérunt et adoravérunt omnes pingues terræ; in conspéctu ejus cadent omnes qui descéndunt in terram.
verses.eng: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and have adored: all they that go down to the earth shall fall before Him.

verses.lat: Et ánima mea illi vivet, et semen meum sérviet ipsi.
verses.eng: And to Him my soul shall live: and my seed shall serve Him.

verses.lat: Annuntiábitur Dómino generátio ventúra; et annuntiábunt cæli justítiam ejus pópulo qui nascétur, quem fecit Dóminus.
verses.eng: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: and the heavens shall show forth His justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy.

verses.lat: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea, et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco, et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi et malum coram te feci; ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum, et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold, I was conceived in iniquities: and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti; incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold, Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor; lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam, et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis, et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins: and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus, et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua, et Spíritum Sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face: and take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui, et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation: and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas, et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ, et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries, et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique; holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus; cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion, ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion: that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta; tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine; intéllege clamórem meum.
verses.eng: Give ear, O Lord, to my words: understand my cry.

verses.lat: Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
verses.eng: Hearken to the voice of my prayer, O my King and my God.

verses.lat: Quóniam ad te orábo; Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
verses.eng: For to Thee will I pray: O Lord, in the morning Thou shalt hear my voice.

verses.lat: Mane astábo tibi et vidébo, quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.
verses.eng: In the morning I will stand before Thee and will see: because Thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

verses.lat: Neque habitábit juxta te malígnus, neque permanébunt injústi ante óculos tuos.
verses.eng: Neither shall the wicked dwell near Thee: nor shall the unjust abide before Thy eyes.

verses.lat: Odísti omnes qui operántur iniquitátem; perdes omnes qui loquúntur mendácium.
verses.eng: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: Thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie.

verses.lat: Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus.
verses.eng: The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor.

verses.lat: Ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ introíbo in domum tuam; adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.
verses.eng: But as for me, in the multitude of Thy mercy, I will come into Thy house: I will worship towards Thy holy temple, in Thy fear.

verses.lat: Dómine, deduc me in justítia tua; propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
verses.eng: Conduct me, O Lord, in Thy justice: because of my enemies, direct my way in Thy sight.

verses.lat: Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas; cor eórum vanum est.
verses.eng: For there is no truth in their mouth: their heart is vain.

verses.lat: Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum; linguis suis dolóse agébant. Júdica illos, Deus.
verses.eng: Their throat is an open sepulchre: they dealt deceitfully with their tongues. Judge them, O God.

verses.lat: Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis; secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.
verses.eng: Let them fall from their devices: according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out, for they have provoked Thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et læténtur omnes qui sperant in te; in ætérnum exsultábunt, et habitábis in eis.
verses.eng: But let all them be glad that hope in Thee: they shall rejoice for ever, and Thou shalt dwell in them.

verses.lat: Et gloriabúntur in te omnes qui díligunt nomen tuum, quóniam tu benedíces justo.
verses.eng: And all they that love Thy name shall glory in Thee: for Thou wilt bless the just.

verses.lat: Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti nos.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou hast crowned us as with a shield of Thy good will.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, quóniam irátus es mihi; convérsus est furor tuus, et consolátus es me.
verses.eng: I will give thanks to Thee, O Lord, for Thou wast angry with me: Thy wrath is turned away, and Thou hast comforted me.

verses.lat: Ecce Deus salvátor meus, fiduciáliter agam et non timébo.
verses.eng: Behold, God is my saviour: I will deal confidently, and will not fear.

verses.lat: Quia fortitúdo mea et laus mea Dóminus, et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: Because the Lord is my strength and my praise, and He is become my salvation.

verses.lat: Hauriétis aquas in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris.
verses.eng: You shall draw waters with joy out of the saviour's fountains.

verses.lat: Et dicétis in die illa: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus.
verses.eng: And you shall say in that day: Praise ye the Lord, and call upon His name.

verses.lat: Notas fácite in pópulis adinventiónes ejus; mementóte quóniam excélsum est nomen ejus.
verses.eng: Make His works known among the people: remember that His name is high.

verses.lat: Cantáte Dómino, quóniam magnífice fecit; annuntiáte hoc in univérsa terra.
verses.eng: Sing ye to the Lord, for He hath done great things: show this forth in all the earth.

verses.lat: Exsúlta et lauda, habitátio Sion, quia magnus in médio tui Sanctus Israël.
verses.eng: Rejoice and praise, O thou habitation of Sion: for great is He that is in the midst of thee, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus vocem oratiónis meæ.
verses.eng: I have loved, because the Lord will hear the voice of my prayer.

verses.lat: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi, et in diébus meis invocábo.
verses.eng: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me: and in my days I will call upon Him.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis, et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
verses.eng: The sorrows of death have compassed me: and the perils of hell have found me.

verses.lat: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni, et nomen Dómini invocávi.
verses.eng: I met with trouble and sorrow: and I called upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam. Miséricors Dóminus et justus, et Deus noster miserétur.
verses.eng: O Lord, deliver my soul. The Lord is merciful and just, and our God showeth mercy.

verses.lat: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus; humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
verses.eng: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: I was humbled, and He delivered me.

verses.lat: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam, quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
verses.eng: Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

verses.lat: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte, óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
verses.eng: For He hath delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

verses.lat: Placébo Dómino in regióne vivórum.
verses.eng: I will please the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum; ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.
verses.eng: I have believed, therefore have I spoken: but I have been humbled exceedingly.

verses.lat: Ego dixi in excéssu meo: Omnis homo mendax.
verses.eng: I said in my excess: Every man is a liar.

verses.lat: Quid retríbuam Dómino pro ómnibus quæ retríbuit mihi?
verses.eng: What shall I render to the Lord for all the things that He hath rendered to me?

verses.lat: Cálicem salutáris accípiam, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.eng: I will take the chalice of salvation: and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus. Pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum ejus.
verses.eng: I will pay my vows to the Lord before all His people. Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints.

verses.lat: O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus; ego servus tuus et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.
verses.eng: O Lord, for I am Thy servant: I am Thy servant, and the son of Thy handmaid.

verses.lat: Dirupísti víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.eng: Thou hast broken my bonds: I will sacrifice to Thee the sacrifice of praise, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli ejus, in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all His people, in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi, et exaudívit me.
verses.eng: In my trouble I cried to the Lord: and He heard me.

verses.lat: Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis et a lingua dolósa.
verses.eng: O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, and a deceitful tongue.

verses.lat: Quid detur tibi aut quid apponátur tibi ad linguam dolósam?
verses.eng: What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, to a deceitful tongue?

verses.lat: Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
verses.eng: The sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals that lay waste.

verses.lat: Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est! Habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar;
verses.eng: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar;

verses.lat: Multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
verses.eng: My soul hath been long a sojourner.

verses.lat: Cum his qui odérunt pacem eram pacíficus; cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
verses.eng: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them, they fought against me without cause.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Levávi óculos meos in montes: unde véniet auxílium mihi.
verses.eng: I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, from whence help shall come to me.

verses.lat: Auxílium meum a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: My help is from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum, neque dormítet qui custódit te.
verses.eng: May He not suffer thy foot to be moved: neither let Him slumber that keepeth thee.

verses.lat: Ecce non dormitábit neque dórmiet, qui custódit Israël.
verses.eng: Behold, He shall neither slumber nor sleep, that keepeth Israel.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódit te; Dóminus protéctio tua super manum déxteram tuam.
verses.eng: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy protection upon thy right hand.

verses.lat: Per diem sol non uret te, neque luna per noctem.
verses.eng: The sun shall not burn thee by day: nor the moon by night.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo; custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: may the Lord keep thy soul.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum et éxitum tuum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out, from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómini est terra, et plenitúdo ejus: orbis terrárum, et univérsi qui hábitant in eo.
verses.eng: The earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof: the world, and all they that dwell therein.

verses.lat: Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum, et super flúmina præparávit eum.
verses.eng: For He hath founded it upon the seas, and hath prepared it upon the rivers.

verses.lat: Quis ascéndet in montem Dómini? Aut quis stabit in loco sancto ejus?
verses.eng: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord? Or who shall stand in His holy place?

verses.lat: Innocens mánibus et mundo corde, qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam, nec jurávit in dolo próximo suo.
verses.eng: The innocent in hands, and clean of heart, who hath not taken his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.

verses.lat: Hic accípiet benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo.
verses.eng: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Saviour.

verses.lat: Hæc est generátio quæréntium eum, quæréntium fáciem Dei Jacob.
verses.eng: This is the generation of them that seek Him, of them that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

verses.lat: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevamini, portæ æternáles: et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.lat: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? Dóminus fortis et potens: Dóminus potens in prœlio.
verses.eng: Who is this King of Glory? The Lord who is strong and mighty: the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.lat: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevamini, portæ æternáles: et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.lat: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? Dóminus virtútum, ipse est Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: Who is this King of Glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of Glory.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Júdica me, Dómine, quóniam ego in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: et in Dómino sperans non infirmábor.
verses.eng: Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my innocence: and I have put my trust in the Lord, and shall not be weakened.

verses.lat: Proba me, Dómine, et tenta me: ure renes meos et cor meum.
verses.eng: Prove me, O Lord, and try me: burn my reins and my heart.

verses.lat: Quóniam misericórdia tua ante óculos meos est: et complácui in veritáte tua.
verses.eng: For Thy mercy is before my eyes: and I am well pleased with Thy truth.

verses.lat: Non sedi cum concílio vanitátis: et cum iníqua gérentibus non introíbo.
verses.eng: I have not sat with the council of vanity: neither will I go in with the doers of unjust things.

verses.lat: Odívi ecclésiam malignántium: et cum ímpiis non sedébo.
verses.eng: I have hated the assembly of the malignant: and with the wicked I will not sit.

verses.lat: Lavábo inter innocéntes manus meas: et circúmdabo altáre tuum, Dómine:
verses.eng: I will wash my hands among the innocent: and will compass Thy altar, O Lord:

verses.lat: Ut áudiam vocem laudis, et enárrem univérsa mirabília tua.
verses.eng: That I may hear the voice of Thy praise: and tell of all Thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: Dómine, diléxi decórem domus tuæ, et locum habitátiónis glóriæ tuæ.
verses.eng: I have loved, O Lord, the beauty of Thy house, and the place where Thy glory dwelleth.

verses.lat: Ne perdas cum ímpiis, Deus, ánimam meam, et cum viris sánguinum vitam meam:
verses.eng: Take not away my soul, O God, with the wicked: nor my life with bloody men:

verses.lat: In quorum mánibus iniquitátes sunt: déxtera eórum repléta est munéribus.
verses.eng: In whose hands are iniquities: their right hand is filled with gifts.

verses.lat: Ego autem in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: rédime me, et miserére mei.
verses.eng: But as for me, I have walked in my innocence: redeem me, and have mercy on me.

verses.lat: Pes meus stetit in dirécto: in ecclésiis benedícam te, Dómine.
verses.eng: My foot hath stood in the direct way: in the churches I will bless Thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Afférte Dómino, fílii Dei: afférte Dómino fílios aríetum.
verses.eng: Bring to the Lord, O ye children of God: bring to the Lord the offspring of rams.

verses.lat: Afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem, afférte Dómino glóriam nómini ejus: adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto ejus.
verses.eng: Bring to the Lord glory and honour: bring to the Lord glory to His name: adore ye the Lord in His holy court.

verses.lat: Vox Dómini super aquas, Deus majestátis intónuit: Dóminus super aquas multas.
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of majesty hath thundered: the Lord is upon many waters.

verses.lat: Vox Dómini in virtúte: vox Dómini in magnificéntia.
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord is in power: the voice of the Lord in magnificence.

verses.lat: Vox Dómini confringéntis cedros: et confrínget Dóminus cedros Líbani:
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars: yea, the Lord shall break the cedars of Libanus.

verses.lat: Et comminúet eas tamquam vítulum Líbani: et diléctus quemadmodum fílius unicórnium.
verses.eng: And shall reduce them to pieces, as a calf of Libanus: and as the beloved son of unicorns.

verses.lat: Vox Dómini intercidéntis flammam ignis:
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord divideth the flame of fire:

verses.lat: Vox Dómini concutíentis desértum: et commovébit Dóminus desértum Cades.
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord shaketh the desert: and the Lord shall shake the desert of Cades.

verses.lat: Vox Dómini præparántis cervos, et revelábit condénsa: et in templo ejus omnes dicent glóriam.
verses.eng: The voice of the Lord prepareth the stags: and He will discover the thick woods: and in His temple all shall speak His glory.

verses.lat: Dóminus dilúvium inhabítare facit: et sedébit Dóminus Rex in ætérnum.
verses.eng: The Lord maketh the flood to dwell: and the Lord shall sit King for ever.

verses.lat: Dóminus virtútem pópulo suo dabit: Dóminus benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
verses.eng: The Lord will give strength to His people: the Lord will bless His people with peace.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
verses.eng: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

verses.lat: Beátus vir cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, nec est in spíritu ejus dolus.
verses.eng: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.lat: Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, dum clamárem tota die.
verses.eng: Because I was silent, my bones grew old, whilst I cried out all the day long.

verses.lat: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
verses.eng: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me: I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

verses.lat: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: et injustítiam meam non abscóndi.
verses.eng: I have acknowledged my sin to Thee, and my injustice I have not concealed.

verses.lat: Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me injustítiam meam Dómino: et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
verses.eng: I said: I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: and Thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

verses.lat: Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, in témpore opportúno.
verses.eng: For this shall every one that is holy pray to Thee in a seasonable time.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, ad eum non approximábunt.
verses.eng: And yet in a flood of many waters, they shall not come nigh unto Him.

verses.lat: Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne quæ circúmdedit me: exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
verses.eng: Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

verses.lat: Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac qua gradiéris: firmábo super te óculos meos.
verses.eng: I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way in which thou shalt go: I will fix My eyes upon thee.

verses.lat: Nolíte fiéri sicut equus et mulus, quibus non est intelléctus.
verses.eng: Do not become like the horse and the mule, who have no understanding.

verses.lat: In camo et fræno maxíllas eórum constrínge, qui non appróximant ad te.
verses.eng: With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, who come not near unto Thee.

verses.lat: Multa flagélla peccatóris, sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
verses.eng: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

verses.lat: Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, justi, et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
verses.eng: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, and glory, all ye right of heart.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: semper laus ejus in ore meo.
verses.eng: I will bless the Lord at all times: His praise shall be always in my mouth.

verses.lat: In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: aúdiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
verses.eng: In the Lord shall my soul be praised: let the meek hear and rejoice.

verses.lat: Magnifícáte Dóminum mecum: et exaltémus nomen ejus in idípsum.
verses.eng: O magnify the Lord with me: and let us extol His name together.

verses.lat: Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis eripúit me.
verses.eng: I sought the Lord, and He heard me: and He delivered me from all my troubles.

verses.lat: Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
verses.eng: Come ye to Him and be enlightened: and your faces shall not be confounded.

verses.lat: Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus ejus salvávit eum.
verses.eng: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.lat: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: et eripíet eos.
verses.eng: The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear Him: and shall deliver them.

verses.lat: Gustáte et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: beátus vir qui sperat in eo.
verses.eng: O taste and see that the Lord is sweet: blessed is the man that hopeth in Him.

verses.lat: Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti ejus: quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
verses.eng: Fear the Lord, all ye His saints: for there is no want to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
verses.eng: The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

verses.lat: Veníte, fílii, audíte me: timórem Dómini docébo vos.
verses.eng: Come, children, hearken to me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.lat: Quis est homo qui vult vitam: díligit dies vidére bonos?
verses.eng: Who is the man that desireth life: who loveth to see good days?

verses.lat: Prohíbe linguam tuam a malo: et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
verses.eng: Keep thy tongue from evil: and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.lat: Devérte a malo, et fac bonum: inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
verses.eng: Turn away from evil, and do good: seek after peace, and pursue it.

verses.lat: Óculi Dómini super justos: et aures ejus in preces eórum.
verses.eng: The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: and His ears unto their prayers.

verses.lat: Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
verses.eng: But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.lat: Clamávérunt justi, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: The just cried, and the Lord heard them: and delivered them out of all their troubles.

verses.lat: Juxta est Dóminus iis qui tribuláto sunt corde: et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
verses.eng: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: and He will save the humble of spirit.

verses.lat: Multæ tribulatiónes justórum: et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
verses.eng: Many are the afflictions of the just: but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

verses.lat: Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: unum ex his non conterétur.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth all their bones: not one of them shall be broken.

verses.lat: Mors peccatórum péssima: et qui odérunt justum delínquent.
verses.eng: The death of the wicked is very evil: and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

verses.lat: Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
verses.eng: The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants: and none of them that trust in Him shall offend.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dixit injústus ut delínquat in semetipso: non est timor Dei ante óculos ejus.
verses.eng: The unjust hath said within himself, that he would sin: there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.lat: Quóniam dolóse egit in conspéctu ejus: ut inveniátur iníquitas ejus ad ódium.
verses.eng: For in his sight he hath done deceitfully: that his iniquity may be found unto hatred.

verses.lat: Verba oris ejus iníquitas et dolus: nóluit intellígere ut bene ágeret.
verses.eng: The words of his mouth are iniquity and guile: he would not understand that he might do well.

verses.lat: Iniquitátem meditátus est in cubíli suo: ástitit omni viæ non bonæ, malítiam autem non odívit.
verses.eng: He hath devised iniquity on his bed: he hath set himself on every way that is not good, and he hath not hated evil.

verses.lat: Dómine, in cælo misericórdia tua: et véritas tua usque ad nubes.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thy mercy is in heaven: and Thy truth reacheth even to the clouds.

verses.lat: Justítia tua sicut montes Dei: judícia tua abýssus multa.
verses.eng: Thy justice is as the mountains of God: Thy judgments are a great deep.

verses.lat: Hómines et juménta salvábis, Dómine: quemadmodum multiplicásti misericórdiam tuam, Deus.
verses.eng: Men and beasts Thou wilt preserve, O Lord: O how hast Thou multiplied Thy mercy, O God!

verses.lat: Fílii autem hóminum in tégmine alárum tuárum sperábunt.
verses.eng: But the children of men shall put their trust under the covert of Thy wings.

verses.lat: Inebriabúntur ab ubértate domus tuæ: et torrénte voluptátis tuæ potábis eos.
verses.eng: They shall be inebriated with the plenty of Thy house: and Thou shalt make them drink of the torrent of Thy pleasure.

verses.lat: Quóniam apud te est fons vitæ: et in lúmine tuo vidébimus lumen.
verses.eng: For with Thee is the fountain of life: and in Thy light we shall see light.

verses.lat: Præténde misericórdiam tuam sciéntibus te, et justítiam tuam his qui recto sunt corde.
verses.eng: Extend Thy mercy to them that know Thee, and Thy justice to them that are right in heart.

verses.lat: Non véniat mihi pes supérbiæ: et manus peccatóris non móveat me.
verses.eng: Let not the foot of pride come to me: and let not the hand of the sinner move me.

verses.lat: Ibi cecidérunt qui operántur iniquitátem: expúlsi sunt, nec potuérunt stare.
verses.eng: There the workers of iniquity are fallen: they are cast out, and could not stand.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Noli æmulári in malignántibus: neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
verses.eng: Be not emulous of evildoers: nor envy them that work iniquity.

verses.lat: Quóniam tamquam fœnum velóciter aréscent: et quemadmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
verses.eng: For they shall shortly wither away as grass: and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

verses.lat: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis ejus.
verses.eng: Trust in the Lord, and do good: and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

verses.lat: Delectare in Dómino: et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
verses.eng: Delight in the Lord: and He will give thee the requests of thy heart.

verses.lat: Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: et ipse fáciet.
verses.eng: Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in Him: and He will do it.

verses.lat: Et edúcet quasi lumen justítiam tuam, et judícium tuum tamquam merídiem:
verses.eng: And He will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday:

verses.lat: Súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum. Noli æmulári in eo qui prosperátur in via sua: in hómine faciénte injustítias.
verses.eng: Be subject to the Lord, and pray to Him. Envy not the man who prospereth in his way: the man who doth unjust things.

verses.lat: Désine ab ira, et derélinque furórem: noli æmulári ut malígne ris.
verses.eng: Cease from anger, and leave rage: have no emulation to do evil.

verses.lat: Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminaúntur: sustinentes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
verses.eng: For evildoers shall be cut off: but they that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the land.

verses.lat: Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccatór: et quæres locum ejus, et non invénies.
verses.eng: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

verses.lat: Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: et delectábuntur in multitúdíne pacis.
verses.eng: But the meek shall inherit the land: and shall delight in abundance of peace.

verses.lat: Observábit peccatór justum: et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
verses.eng: The sinner shall watch the just man: and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem irridébit eum: quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies ejus.
verses.eng: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for He foreseeth that his day shall come.

verses.lat: Gládium evagénvérunt peccatóres: intendérunt arcum suum, ut déjiciant páuperem et ínopem, ut trucident rectos corde.
verses.eng: The wicked have drawn out the sword: they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill the upright of heart.

verses.lat: Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: et arcus eórum confringátur.
verses.eng: Let their sword enter into their own hearts: and let their bow be broken.

verses.lat: Mélius est módicum justo, super divítias peccatórum multas.
verses.eng: Better is a little to the just, than the great riches of the wicked.

verses.lat: Quóniam bráchia peccatórum conteréntur: confírmat autem justos Dóminus.
verses.eng: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces: but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

verses.lat: Novit Dóminus dies immaculátórum: et héreditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
verses.eng: The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.lat: Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturábuntur:
verses.eng: They shall not be confounded in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be filled:

verses.lat: Quia peccatóres períbunt.
verses.eng: Because the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Inimíci vero Dómini mox ut honoráti fúerint et exaltáti: deficiéntes, quemadmodum fumus deficient.
verses.eng: But the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted: shall consume and vanish like smoke.

verses.lat: Mutuábitur peccatór, et non solvet: justus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
verses.eng: The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again: but the just showeth mercy and shall give.

verses.lat: Quia benedicentes ei hereditábunt terram: maledicentes autem ei disperiíbunt.
verses.eng: For such as bless Him shall inherit the land: but such as curse Him shall perish.

verses.lat: Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: et viam ejus volet.
verses.eng: With the Lord shall the steps of a man be directed: and He shall like well his way.

verses.lat: Cum cecíderit, non collidétur: quia Dóminus supónit manum suam.
verses.eng: When he shall fall, he shall not be bruised: for the Lord putteth His hand under him.

verses.lat: Júnior fui, étenim sénui: et non vidi justum derelidum, nec semen ejus quærens panem.
verses.eng: I have been young, and now am old: and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

verses.lat: Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
verses.eng: He showeth mercy, and lendeth all the day long: and his seed shall be in blessing.

verses.lat: Declína a malo, et fac bonum: et inhábita in sæculum sæculi.
verses.eng: Decline from evil, and do good: and dwell for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Quia Dóminus amat judícium, et non derelinquet sanctos suos: in ætérnum conservábuntur.
verses.eng: For the Lord loveth judgment, and will not forsake His saints: they shall be preserved for ever.

verses.lat: Injústi puniéntur: et semen impiórum períbit.
verses.eng: The unjust shall be punished: and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Justi autem hereditábunt terram: et inhabitábunt in sæculum sæculi super eam.
verses.eng: But the just shall inherit the land: and shall dwell therein for evermore.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Os justi meditábitur sapiéntiam: et lingua ejus loquétur judícium.
verses.eng: The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: and his tongue shall speak judgment.

verses.lat: Lex Dei ejus in corde ipsíus: et non supplantábuntur gressus ejus.
verses.eng: The law of his God is in his heart: and his steps shall not be supplanted.

verses.lat: Consíderat peccatór justum: et quærit mortáre eum.
verses.eng: The wicked watcheth the just man: and seeketh to put him to death.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem non derelinquet eum in mánibus ejus: nec damnábit eum cum judicábitur illi.
verses.eng: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands: nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

verses.lat: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam ejus: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: cum períbunt peccatóres, vidébis.
verses.eng: Expect the Lord, and keep His way: and He will exalt thee to inherit the land: when the sinners shall perish, thou shalt see.

verses.lat: Vidi impíum superexaltátum, et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
verses.eng: I have seen the wicked highly exalted, and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

verses.lat: Et transívi, et ecce non erat: et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus ejus.
verses.eng: And I passed by, and lo, he was not: and I sought him, and his place was not found.

verses.lat: Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
verses.eng: Keep innocence, and behold justice: for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

verses.lat: Injústi autem disperiíbunt simul: relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
verses.eng: But the unjust shall be destroyed together: the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Salus autem justórum a Dómino: et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
verses.eng: But the salvation of the just is from the Lord: and He is their protector in the time of trouble.

verses.lat: Et adjuvábit eos Dóminus, et liberábit eos: et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos, quia sperávérunt in eo.
verses.eng: And the Lord will help them, and deliver them: and He will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in Him.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy indignation, nor chastise me in Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
verses.eng: For Thy arrows are fastened in me: and Thy hand hath been strong upon me.

verses.lat: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
verses.eng: There is no health in my flesh, because of Thy wrath: there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
verses.eng: For my iniquities are gone over my head: and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

verses.lat: Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, a fácie insipíentiæ meæ.
verses.eng: My sores are putrefied and corrupted, because of my foolishness.

verses.lat: Miser factus sum et curvátus sum usque in finem: tota die contrístátus ingrediébar.
verses.eng: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: I walked sorrowful all the day long.

verses.lat: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: et non est sánitas in carne mea.
verses.eng: For my loins are filled with illusions: and there is no health in my flesh.

verses.lat: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
verses.eng: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: I roared with the groaning of my heart.

verses.lat: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
verses.eng: Lord, all my desire is before Thee: and my groaning is not hidden from Thee.

verses.lat: Cor meum conturbatum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
verses.eng: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me: and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

verses.lat: Amíci mei et próximi mei advérsum me appropiquávérunt, et stetérunt.
verses.eng: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me.

verses.lat: Et qui juxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
verses.eng: And they that were near me stood afar off: and they that sought my soul used violence.

verses.lat: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: et dolos tota die meditábantur.
verses.eng: And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things: and studied deceits all the day long.

verses.lat: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
verses.eng: But I, as a deaf man, heard not: and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

verses.lat: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
verses.eng: And I became as a man that heareth not: and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

verses.lat: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: tu exaudies, Dómine Deus meus.
verses.eng: For in Thee, O Lord, have I hoped: Thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

verses.lat: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: et dum commóventur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
verses.eng: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

verses.lat: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
verses.eng: For I am ready for scourges: and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
verses.eng: For I will declare my iniquity: and I will think for my sin.

verses.lat: Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
verses.eng: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.lat: Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
verses.eng: They that render evil for good have detracted me: because I followed goodness.

verses.lat: Ne derelinquas me, Dómine Deus meus: ne discésseris a me.
verses.eng: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: do not Thou depart from me.

verses.lat: Inténde in adjutórium meum, Dómine Deus salútis meæ.
verses.eng: Attend unto my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy.

verses.lat: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Amplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold, I was conceived in iniquities: and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold, Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.
